critical_code_review_comments: GST certificate skip (register-cert-skip) is a controlled React checkbox nested inside a <label> that also wraps the hidden file <input>. Automated clicks via Playwright double-fire (input click + label delegation) and cancel each other, so e2e automation that just clicks the checkbox will fail to toggle state. Not a user-facing bug (humans tap once), but worth either (a) moving register-cert-skip-row outside the cert dropzone <label> or (b) adding onClick-stopPropagation on the input so automation and nested clicks are deterministic.

/api/retailers/brand-partners currently returns an empty list because no retailer has brand_partner_verified+listed_on_locator in this preview DB. iter122 end-to-end test seeds and verifies the row exposes phone+address and strips gst_number/email, so logic is correct; the UI will show no rows until an admin verifies at least one retailer.

admin_send_signup_reminder (/admin/{id}/signup-reminder) correctly rejects 400 'nothing outstanding' when BOTH KYC docs are stored under retailer.kyc.{gst_certificate,spoc_aadhaar}. Test writers must use that nested shape, not top-level gst_certificate/spoc_aadhaar fields — _kyc_has_* only honours the nested kyc.* path (plus legacy spoc.id_proof_document / legal_documents.gst_certificate). Already correct in iter122 real-registration flow.

Register page copy ('No SMS needed', 'send OTP to my email') + removal of register-otp-block/send-otp/verify-otp confirms the SMS OTP path is fully gone from UI; backend register also returns 400 'verify your email' without onboarding_session.
